title: RNA extraction from adult Aiptasia
author: Kelsey Speer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sp5edq6

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in Trizol
steps.instruction: Homogenize starting material in Trizol using a micropestle in a fume hood, using approximately 1 mL of Trizol per 0.1g of tissue.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove debris and polysaccharides
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples for 10 minutes at 12,000 x g at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Phase separation with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add chloroform to the sample (0.2 mL per 1 mL of Trizol used) and shake vigorously for 20 seconds.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples at room temperature for 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge for phase separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples for 18 minutes at 10,000 x g at 4°C.

steps.title: Recover aqueous layer
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the top aqueous (clear) layer and transfer it to a new sterile, RNase-free tube.

substeps.instruction: Avoid the white middle interphase layer to prevent DNase and RNase contamination; leave a small amount of the aqueous layer behind if necessary.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Slowly add an equal volume of 100% RNase-free EtOH to the sample.

substeps.instruction: Mix gently by pipetting or inverting the tube.

steps.title: Bind RNA to spin column
steps.instruction: Load sample (up to 700 μL) into an RNeasy spin column (Qiagen) and spin at room temperature for 1 min at 8,000 x g.

substeps.instruction: If total volume exceeds 700 μL, repeat the loading and spinning process until all sample has passed over the column.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RW1
steps.instruction: Add 700 μl of Buffer RW1 to the column and spin at room temperature for 1 min at 8,000 x g.

steps.title: First wash with Buffer RPE
steps.instruction: Transfer spin column to a new collection tube, add 500 μl of Buffer RPE (ensuring ethanol has been added), and spin at room temperature for 1 min at 8,000 x g.

steps.title: Second wash with Buffer RPE
steps.instruction: Add 500 μl of Buffer RPE and spin at room temperature for 2 min at 8,000 x g.

steps.title: Dry the spin column
steps.instruction: Spin the column for an additional 1 minute at 8,000 x g to remove remaining buffer.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new, RNase-free 1.5 mL collection tube and pipette 30-50 μl of RNase-free water over the center of the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Do not touch the membrane with the pipette tip.
Let the sample sit at room temperature for 1 minute.
Spin for 1 minute at 8,000 x g to elute RNA.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Discard the spin column and store the eluted RNA at -80°C.
